row.title: LANE-WORKER-MERGE-1: workflow-changing PRs merge through the tick Worker's GitHub App
row.body: No LANE_PAT or app secret is bound, so PRs changing .github/workflows waited for a hand merge. The lane now asks the tick Worker (/api/lane/merge, OIDC proof, exact head, green guard) to merge with the org app, which holds workflows: write.
